verdict.rationale: Sentry ships a built-in AI agent (Seer/Seer Agent) that users can delegate tasks to directly inside the product: automatically scanning issues and root-causing them, generating fixes and PRs (Autofix), reviewing code changes, and answering ad-hoc questions about telemetry (Seer Agent) — all documented as first-party in-product features rather than an external tool. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Seer's task delegation accuracy and reliability (only vendor docs are cited, no community confirmation of Seer specifically).
